subject.title: fix(openai): align auth availability with effective routes

question: Should provider route-resolution and harness transport-compatibility facts become a supported permanent Plugin SDK contract in this PR?
rationale: The implementation fixes a real correctness bug but also creates a long-term external compatibility promise and changes implicit OpenAI runtime selection; code review cannot authorize that product/API direction.

options.title: Approve after compatibility repairs
options.body: Keep the public contract, fix every exact-head regression, and require focused upgrade and contract proof before merge.

options.title: Internalize the route facts
options.body: Retain the OpenAI correction behind bundled internal surfaces until a narrower external API is separately approved.

options.title: Pause the broad migration
options.body: Replace this branch with a smaller compatibility-preserving fix if the public contract is not desired.

recommendation.title: Approve after compatibility repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the public contract, fix every exact-head regression, and require focused upgrade and contract proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history covers the OpenAI provider identity, Codex auth bridge, prepared auth stores, and Plugin SDK documentation involved in this decision.
